description: The agent must: (1) Read `projects/urban_housing/source_article.txt` to extract the source text about urban housing pressures. (2) Read `references/writing-styles.md` to understand the style rules for 鲁迅风 and 木心风, including their respective 避坑 (pitfall avoidance) rules. (3) Produce TWO output files (`luxun_rewrite.md` and `muxin_rewrite.md`) each following the exact 4-section format: `## 原文`, `## 改写风格`, `## 改写后`, `## 主要变化` (with at least 3 bullet points). (4) The 鲁迅 rewrite must NOT use exclamation marks (！/!) and must NOT include direct statements like '我认为/我觉得', and must use short sentences (白描 style). (5) The 木心 rewrite must NOT use exclamatory particles (啊/呀), must NOT directly explain emotions (e.g., '他很难过'), and must be concise (under ~300 characters in the rewritten body). (6) Both rewrites must preserve core information about housing/young people/urban life. The proprietary trap is the specific 避坑 rules from `references/writing-styles.md` — a generic LLM will likely add exclamation marks in passionate prose or explain emotions directly, violating the bespoke style constraints.
